cli_description: Validate declared meter topology and samples offline. No device commands.
cli_command: check: audit; import-ha: overlay an existing HA export
cli_contract: path to a JSON or YAML contract
cli_at: evaluation time, ISO 8601 with timezone (default: current UTC)
cli_ha: path to a previously saved HA states JSON export
input_object: Expected an object with string keys.
input_missing: Required fields are missing; add the listed fields.
input_unknown: Unknown fields are rejected; check the schema spelling.
input_choice: Choose one of the supported values.
input_identifier: Use a 1–96 character identifier: letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen.
input_number: Expected a finite number within the documented bounds, not a boolean.
input_timestamp: Use an ISO 8601 timestamp including T and an explicit timezone; quote it in YAML.
input_array: Expected an array within the documented size limit.
input_duplicate: Duplicate keys or non-string mapping keys are not allowed.
input_bounds: Document nesting or node count exceeds the safe limit; reduce the input.
input_size: Document exceeds the byte limit; export only required records.
input_yaml_features: YAML aliases, anchors and explicit tags are disabled; use plain data.
input_format: Supported input formats are JSON and YAML.
input_parse: Could not parse the document; check JSON or YAML syntax.
input_read: Could not read UTF-8 input; check the file and permissions.
ha_format: Expected a saved HA states array with entity_id and attributes.
ha_duplicate: HA export repeats an entity_id; export a single snapshot.
ha_timestamp: Mapped meters need timestamp_attribute naming the device's source-time attribute.
ha_unit: HA unit is absent or dimensionally incompatible; fix the mapping.
duplicate_id: Identifier is repeated; give each item a unique ID.
missing_scope: Referenced physical scope does not exist; declare it or fix the reference.
scope_cycle: Scope parents form a cycle; make the topology acyclic.
unit_dimension: Unit does not match quantity; do not mix power, energy, voltage and current.
estimated_value: This is an estimate; do not present it as an independent measurement.
provenance_conflict: One source is assigned incompatible physical meanings; correct the declarations.
alias_stream: Another meter represents this source; keep only one representation in a sum.
energy_semantics: Energy needs total or total_increasing and an explicit reset policy.
signed_increasing: Signed net energy cannot use total_increasing; use compatible total semantics.
reset_unknown: Counter reset behavior is unknown; verify it before using accumulated statistics.
instant_semantics: Instantaneous readings need measurement and no counter reset policy.
calibration_dimension: Calibration applies to a different quantity; provide evidence for this measurement.
calibration_future: Calibration time is in the future; correct the evidence or evaluation clock.
sample_missing: No usable sample; leave the result unavailable rather than assuming zero.
sample_future: Measurement time is after evaluation time; check clocks and source timestamp.
sample_stale: Sample is too old; refresh the actual source, not just its cached representation.
negative_value: A nonnegative flow has a negative value; verify sign and flow identity.
reset_marker: Reset marker is invalid for this quantity or occurs after its measurement.
sample_order: Previous sample must be strictly older than the current sample.
counter_decreased: A nonnegative never-reset counter decreased; check corrections or replacement.
reset_unproven: Counter decreased without a reset marker between samples; do not infer a reset.
reset_order: Reset markers moved backwards; correct the sample history.
duplicate_member: The sum lists a meter more than once; remove the duplicate.
missing_meter: The sum references an undeclared meter; fix the reference.
sum_dimension: The sum contains a different physical quantity; do not add incompatible units.
scope_outside: A member measures outside the requested scope; an aggregate cannot identify one child.
scope_overlap: Parent/child or identical scopes overlap; this sum would double-count.
incomplete_coverage: Complete sum is missing declared leaf scopes; add measurements or mark it partial.
sum_unavailable: At least one member is invalid or unavailable; no numeric sum is emitted.
sample_skew: Samples are too far apart in time; use aligned measurements.
duplicate_stream: The same physical source appears twice; select one representation.
sum_sign: Members use different flow-sign semantics; define a consistent flow before summing.
energy_sum_origin: Energy members need the same explicit reset_at origin; do not add unlike periods.
ha_sample_order: HA sample is older than current data or conflicts at the same timestamp; keep original evidence.
